chunks: From among the jinn and the men.

key_terms.الْجِنَّةِ: The jinn, unseen creatures created from smokeless fire

ai.seo_question: Who are the two main groups of creation mentioned in Surah An-Nas?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this pairing highlights the dual nature of creation, where both jinn and humans possess free will (ikhtiyar) and are equally accountable for their deeds. This universal address underscores the completeness of the Quranic guidance, which encompasses all rational beings regardless of their visibility, reinforcing the concept of divine justice (adl) across all realms of existence.
